settings.subtitle: A minimal light-work chair that maximises focus without disturbing the room - for home offices, studies and every light-work moment in between.
Move Light, Think Free
settings.heading: MUUVE
settings.alt: SIDIZ MUUVE light work chair in a calm interior
settings.description:
The SIDIZ MUUVE is a light work chair of minimal design that maximises working focus without disturbing the interior.

Recommended for home offices, studies, multi-rooms and living spaces where the room matters as much as the work.

settings.heading: So how do you use a MUUVE?
Light-work moments with the MUUVE, from home office to living-room study

settings.description: A chair chosen after long deliberation should last. The parts that naturally wear with time are designed to swap out, so the chair keeps feeling new - easy to replace, made to last.

settings.description: The seat shows time first; when it wears or stains, replace just the seat and the chair feels new. *Parts available through our support team.

settings.heading: MUUVE dimensions
settings.figures: Maximum load 125 kg / product weight approximately 9 kg.
settings.caveats:
*Measurements may vary by plus or minus 20 mm and 1 kg depending on where and how they are taken; this is not a fault.
*Dimensions are measured with nobody seated.
*Seat height is measured at the centre of the seat.

settings.title: Removing stains
settings.body: If the chair frame gets marked, a melamine sponge lifts stains easily. *Rubbing hard can damage the surface.
settings.alt: Cleaning the chair frame with a melamine sponge

settings.question: Can I swap between castors and glides?
settings.answer: Yes - contact our support team to purchase the alternative base parts and swap them yourself. Note that the seat height changes slightly with the swap.

settings.question: How far does the soft tilting move?
settings.answer: The soft tilting follows your body through roughly 8 degrees upward and 4 degrees downward. The videos on this page show the movement.

settings.question: Can the seat and backrest cushions be washed?
settings.answer: The cushions are not washable, but if they stain or wear with long use, replacements are available through our support team.
